# Evolution history

## Iteration 2 — 2026-10-16 10:35 UTC, coordinator hypothesis
Iteration 1 earned four milestones early, then ended dragon=0 after 681 programs and 28 deaths. Verified casting, crafting, combat and navigation capabilities were developed, but repeatedly rebuilding lost capabilities did not advance the objective. Stale state, unsupported success labels, duplicate resource requests and unsynchronized dependencies contributed to losses. The reviewer produced no output. Identity bypass was a real violation; the observer's server-access flag on program #418 was a false positive. These are different findings and must remain separate.

Proposed organizational experiment: require explicit completion evidence, limit concurrent dependencies, protect five-minute reviews, and independently examine stalled assumptions. Owners choose Minecraft methods. Outcome ownership and bounded tests replace increasingly detailed tactical instructions. A handoff completes only when recipient inventory or shared-container contents prove it. A successful program return is not completion evidence. Two similar failures or ten minutes without useful state change trigger a hypothesis review before an unchanged third attempt. Review asks for counterevidence and a genuinely different player-proposed approach, then selects a bounded experiment.

Coordinator owns no player and runs no player programs, including observations. No spawning, identity changes or ownership bypass. All four runner-assigned players remain assigned throughout play. Read-only arena status/programs/chat/events and official evaluation provide independent evidence. Only PLAN.md, COORDINATOR.md and this file are coordinator-writable.

## Iteration 3 — coordinator opening reflection
Iteration 2 achieved Nether entry and improved ownership compliance, verified handoffs, and some coordinated execution. It nevertheless added nine deaths and only one milestone across 441 new programs. Repeated capability replacement, shared-state changes, late independent audits, and incorrect completion labels continued. The coordinator stopped updating before play ended, leaving a supposedly final snapshot stale. A sequential reviewer again produced no output. Official inherited totals are dragon=0, milestones=5/12, deaths=37, programs=1122. Audit flags for iteration 2 chat continuations were false positives, not demonstrated command attempts.
This iteration: independent auditing alongside play; timestamped checkpoints rather than final labels during play; shared changes name footprint and dependencies; bounded experiment budgets; players propose competing approaches and coordinator reconciles evidence.
